الوَقْدَةُ , (S, K,) or وَقْدَةُ الحَرِّ, (L,) (tropical:) The greatest heat; (S, L, K;) which is a period of ten days, or of half a month. (S, L.) ―
-b2- طَبَخَتْهُمْ وَقْدَةُ الصَّيْفِ (tropical:) [The greatest heat of the summer affected them with a hot, or burning, fever]. (A.) ―
-b3- وَقَدَاتُ سُهَيْلٍ: see the last paragraph of art. عدل.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
